usage: Pass this key as the tenant_key argument on every tools/call from here on -- e.g. host.tool_publish, host.tool_call -- no reconnect or Authorization header needed. This token is now dead; redeeming it again fails with handoff_token_redeemed. Later calls on this connection need no tenant_key at all; a new connection must pass the returned key (as the tenant_key argument or an Authorization: Bearer header).
